run_compute_structure_matches: run structure matching evaluation on all predicted crystal structures in a directory using CSD or pymatgen
run_evaluate_structures_file: run evaluation of predicted crystal structures in a parquet file against experimental reference structures
run_match_structures: run comparison of a single predicted crystal structure against experimental reference structures using CSD or pymatgen
create_ccdc_match_settings: create a CCDC PackingSimilarity object with configurable shell size, hydrogen ignoring, and molecular difference settings
run_get_eval_config_and_method: run extraction of evaluation configuration and method from a config dictionary for CSD or pymatgen
